# lucidity_service_account (Resource)

A Lucidity service account: a non-human identity for scripts and pipelines, with roles per tenant. Create its client ID and secret with lucidity_service_account_credential. Managing service accounts needs an account admin's refresh token: a service account's own credentials can only read. Deleting a service account is permanent: its credentials stop working and its name can't be used again. To pause one, set enabled = false.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Managing service accounts needs an account admin's refresh token: a
# service account's own credentials can only read.
resource "lucidity_service_account" "ci" {
  name        = "ci-deploy-bot"
  description = "GitHub Actions deploy pipeline"

  # Roles per tenant. This is the complete set: a tenant left out has no access.
  permissions = {
    (lucidity_tenant.prod.tenant_id) = ["Viewer", "Editor"]
    (lucidity_tenant.dev.tenant_id)  = ["Viewer"]
  }

  # Deleting a service account is permanent and its name can't be reused.
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, up to 255 characters, unique in the Lucidity account ignoring case. Updatable in place. A deleted service account's name can't be reused.

### Optional

- `description` (String) What the service account is for, up to 1000 characters.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to true. false stops new access tokens without deleting the service account or its credentials; tokens already issued keep working until they expire (up to 15 minutes). Credentials can't be created while it's false.
- `permissions` (Map of Set of String) Roles per tenant: keys are Lucidity tenant IDs (e.g. lucidity_tenant.<name>.tenant_id), values are role names (`Viewer`, `Editor`; see the lucidity_roles data source). This is the complete set: a tenant left out has no access. Leave unset for a service account with no tenant roles; removing it from an existing service account switches its role mapping off (Lucidity keeps the roles stored, but they grant nothing).
- `tenant_id` (String) Lucidity tenant ID (e.g. lucidity_tenant.<name>.tenant_id) to act on, sent as the X-tenant header. Overrides the provider's tenant_id; leave unset to use it. Needed when authenticating as a service account with roles on several tenants.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the service account was created (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Lucidity's ID for the service account. Also the import ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the service account's ID.
terraform import lucidity_service_account.ci 3f1c9e2a-8b4d-4c1e-9a7f-2d5e6b8c0a11
```
